title: repeats
description: research/repeats.json (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 95), written only by wayline/repeats.py through the ledger: the inherited claims the consistency read has read, and every pair of claims the read or the embedding net proposed with the confirmer's label and what came of it: merged into one passage, kept apart (with why), listed as a contradiction, or different; a merge the owner split, and a contradiction the owner marked not one. Merges and contradictions are items of batches (ticket 79), named here by batch and item.

read.description: the inherited claims a consistency read has read; a set holding a claim outside it is read again

a.description: the first occurrence, in reading order

similarity.description: the embedding model's cosine of the two, when the net proposed the pair

outcome.description: merged into one passage; apart, a repeat a check refused to merge; contradiction, both kept and listed; different; split, a merge the owner undid; dismissed, a contradiction the owner marked not one

text.description: the kept text of a merge, without tags

why.description: the confirmer's reason, and why a merge was refused

lost.description: what the confirmer found a merge would lose

added.description: the numbers, symbols, and citations a merge's kept text has that neither occurrence has

flag.description: listed for the grill: a pair kept apart, or one the confirmer flagged

results.description: on a contradiction: the Results headings its claims stand under, whose verification it goes to

batch.description: the merges or contradictions batch it is an item of
